d: This Is CBeebies. Programmes start at 6.00am.
Baby Jake Loves to Copy You. The adventures of magical Baby Jake and friends. Baby Jake and Sydney the Monkey go on a tropical adventure and play copying.
Animation. Sula and Bing tag their favourite things around the house with heart-shaped stickies. When Sula tags Hoppity Voosh, Bing is not sure he wants to share him.
Tralala and Batty try to have a sleepover during the day. Followed by Small Potatoes.
The Piggies help Keith play with his ball, but their mistakes lead to damage everywhere. Things get so bad that Wilf confiscates the ball... Keith can't play? Impossible.
Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the bouncing and singing Cranberries.
Kym takes on her first challenge in Singapore to win the Go Jetters Cup. She must stop Glitch from destroying the famous Merlion to earn her first G.O Star.
Tao asks Mojo and Bo to help him film an action-packed snowboarding video, but Mojo is not so steady on the slopes. Which top can they swap to grab the white-hot snow shots.
The Spy Chuggers are back as the trainees set out on a top secret mission to retrieve a secret surprise gift for Skipper Stu.
Bing makes Sula a picture with all her favourite things on it. It just needs one last jewel to be stuck on, but the glue spills all over the picture.
Sula paints Bing to look like Biteysaurus, but upsets Bing by accidentally adding purple.
Animated preschool series. Happy lets a tap drip, wasting water. The Squirrels think water is limitless, and they explain where they think it comes from.
Animated preschool series. Duggee is taking the Squirrels to the lake, but lots of people have had the same idea and there's a traffic jam.
Dad retells the story of the three little pigs.
Animated adventure comedy series. Kyan is wire-walking across the Grand Canyon, but Glitch wants to cheat and win. Can the Go Jetters stop him.
The Tale of the King of the Woods. Animated series. When Benjamin falls into Mr Tod's clutches, Peter and Lily lure the fox out of his lair with the promise of a crown..
Animated deep sea adventures. Shellington and the Octonauts try to track an unusual creature, a jellyfish that can live forever.
When Fergie's wheelchair breaks from doing an awesome trick, Vida asks Grandpa Beaver to make her a new one so that she can get even better and do more tricks.
A camping trip with Preston goes very wrong when he won't let them use Mojo's tops. But camping Preston's way soon starts a fire. It's Mojo and Bo to the rescue.
My AstroBurp Challenge is ready for launch! We'll blast through squats, star jumps and burpees. Final destination: the Activate.
Justin and his friend get creative with paint at a pottery cafe. Artiste Tumble also has an arty day, painting a portrait of Tumble Ted.
Bluey, Bingo and Mum get into a debate with Dad about the definition of teasing. Dad argues that he was only playing as they recall all the times when he's been a big teaser.
Dad whinges that Bluey and Bingo are too different, so Bluey plans to make them more alike.
Animated preschool series. Duggee and the Squirrels take their teddy bears on a picnic, where they meet a real bear who wants a teddy too so she can join in.
Animated preschool series. The Squirrels tire themselves out with all their activities, so Duggee suggests they take a break and listen to a story.
Winton has terrible toothache but isn't ready to lose his fang. Zog and the doctors must help him feel proud again of the way he looks.
The Piris hike to Tippety Top to see the southern lights but must brave some ice fog.
Rafi wishes for rain so she can splash in puddles with her new boots, and even Aunty T discovers that rain can be lots of fun.
Weasy clones himself so that he can play on his new game console and avoid dad duties.
Picture Perfect Pandemonium/Catch That Panther Pod. Zola steals art. Doc Ock finds Black Panther's tech.
A west African savannah storm intrigues Paani until a mudslide forces Tunip into a ditch.
Big Piggy. The spies race to stop Silver Paw, Pranksy and Glitch from raiding Lauchie's piggy bank.
A Mandarinteryx has moved into home base and is causing a big mess.
It's Supertato's birthday, and Evil Pea shows up to his party with a big evil surprise.
Comedy sketch show for younger viewers. Arthur Sleep has missed the bus so Keith Fitt has a very important job to do: reading the news.
A Very Important Pup visits Pup School for the opening of the brand new bug hotel.
Pippa is making nyama, a chicken stew that uses tasty spring greens.
Aaron and the Buds learn how climbing plants grow tall and reach for the sun.
Too Hot! A paper plate crab is the first make of the day, and an old wooden spoon becomes a spoon monster. The Recycling Express provides yogurt pots to make a palm tree.
With the games in peril, Ava seeks a new chieftain - unaware she is perfect for the role.
Animated preschool series. Naughty Monkey is visited by his cousins, and it turns out they are even naughtier than Naughty Monkey.
Preschool animation. The Octonauts wade through a swamp to find a lost flamingo chick before hungry predators do.
Sunny tags along on house calls to interview Vida for his book... about her. It's a musical.
Can the Go Jetters fix their own 'glitch' at the biggest food fight in the world.
When Cosima finally finds a quiet place to read her book, she realises peace and quiet aren't all they're made out to be. Where's Big Lizard when she needs him.
Yukee's garden friends help turn her 'a day in my life' homework assignment into an exciting, musical sound adventure.
After a garden barbecue, Ziff, Pipp and Button turn straws and snacks into agility games.
Educational series using Makaton sign language. Mr Tumble holds a swimming gala, while Justin and his friends enjoy summer at the seaside.
Matilda and the Fact Pack explore the Wollemi pine, a plant from dinosaur times.
Penny coaches PC Plum for the You Laugh You Lose contest, but it's trickier than expected.
Pearl and Gadabout don't see eye to eye when treating Mara's curly fin.
Bluey, Snickers and Winton are ambushed by the Terriers on the way to see Calypso.
Mae, Bee and the Acorn Exchange. It's Mae and Bee's first Acorn Exchange Day, but Mae's attempts to teach Little Acorn the gnomish way tests Mae's mighty patience to the limit.
Tralala finds the house too noisy until she joins the dust bunnies' rock band.
Rafi makes a wish to be stuck together with Ruby, making playtime special.
Is It Healthy or Not? It's curry night, and Nick writes a song to help him remember to buy lots of healthy ingredients, but will he remember to buy Norman's dog treats.
Love Monster wants to make an epic fort for his friends to play inside but isn't quite sure how. He learns that he needs to make a plan and take it step by step.
Live-action children's show. When Topsy and Tim's friends Tony Welch and Vinda come to play, things don't quite go to plan at first.
Dylan the sculptor wants to sell his statues, but his statues have minds of their own.
Keith is happy to help the Piggies, but their work is sabotaged.
When Yukee's precious clockwork music box breaks, her garden friends cheer her up with a life-size clockwork performance of their own.
Children's sign language poetry series. Aimee and Ashley discover The Spider and the Fly by Mary Botham Howitt.
Trapped! An impatient Great Gnanna gets accidentally trapped with Gadabout in the dispensary. It's a tense time for both of them, while Zog and Pearl race to set them free.
Bluey, Snickers and Winton are ambushed by the Terriers on the way to see Calypso.

t: Andy and the Band: Rock Star School
d: The school is turned into a rock star club - but will it fool a famous rock duo.
It's Time to Look for Frogs. At the wetland centre, JoJo and her friends Alfie, Raya, Jaxon and Isaiah find frog spawn.
Oona and Baba search for soft bedding for their burrow.
I Love Going to Granny and Grandpa's It's Just That ... Animation about a brother and sister. Charlie and Lola are going to see their grandparents, but Lola is worried.
After Colly Wobble loses her shoes, Moon Baby shows her a magical shoe tree in Storyland.
MeMo and BaBa try to create a surprise gift for Gramma Leeba, but something always goes wrong. Gramma Leeba reassures them that the best gift is made with love.
In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures and are read stories. Upsy Daisy gives her special stone to Igglepiggle to look after.
The Shape of My Heart. Join Perrie for a soothing story about the shapes that make up the world we love.
This Is CBeebies. Programmes start at 6.00am.
The adventures of magical Baby Jake and friends. Baby Jake and the Hamsternauts go on a space adventure and enjoy jumping.
Animation. Bing wants Flop to read him his favourite book as he has his bath, but Bing joins in with the story too enthusiastically.
Tralala and Batty use clever mathematics to get enough cake for the guests at their party. Followed by Small Potatoes.
Cherry dreams of soaring through the sky. The Piggies build a plane, but her first flight is a disaster. Cherry begins to doubt herself, but the Piggies won't give up.
Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Coconut getting his moment in the limelight.
Searching for a G.O Star at the Leaning Tower of Pisa, Kym and Lars must stop Glitch from damaging the famous landmark and use the G.O Fix to save the day.
Carrying a giant chicken to the country fair proves trickier than Mojo and Bo expected.
When Safari Park is closed for the day, Koko, Wilson and Brewster give Piper a surprise tour and discover all the exotic wildlife right in their own backyard.
Sula, Pando, Flop and Padget all have a knack, a special thing that only they can do. Bing is frustrated when all his own knacks are easy for everyone else to do, too.
Bing is brave for his vaccination as he is looking forward to the Hoppity Voosh sticker Dr Molly will give him afterwards. But then he finds out that there are none left.
Animated preschool series. It's Enid's birthday. She doesn't like surprises or cakes, so the Squirrels will throw her a dressing up party. But how.
Animated preschool series. Fox, Badger, Mole, Vole and Worm are not getting on. Can Duggee and the Squirrels suggest ways that they can all live peacefully.
Mum is playing the animal game on Bingo's back.
Animated adventure comedy series. When the Grimbots build their own Easter Island statue, it collapses and threatens the ancient Moai statues.
The Tale of the Sleepy Hedgehog. Animated series. When Peter takes Mrs Tiggy-Winkle home in time for winter hibernation, he doesn't realise how much trouble she might be.
Animated deep sea adventures. The Octonauts head to the kelp forest to visit Shellington's sister Pearl and her newborn son Periwinkle.
When Vida's vet bag goes missing, she and her Sweetwoodian friends need to track it down.
Cap'n Gail's tall tale of a nine-legged octopus in Lake Swoppiton has everyone panicking. But Mojo and Bo wonder: is the story real, or is Cap'n Gail up to something.
Oi, oi, shout it from the treetops! It's my Treetops Challenge - from climbers to squats, and then star jumps. Climbing all the way up to the Activate.
Justin and his friend head to a marina for lots of boating fun. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble has ordered a new inflatable boat to take fishing. What could possibly go wrong.
Dad tells Bluey to mind her manners at the table - they're not animals. But when Bluey gets her hands on a stick of magic asparagus, she shows them everyone's got a wild side.
Bluey's bedtime story is disturbed by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world.
Animated preschool series. When the Squirrels find Duggee playing the saxophone, they want to have a go, too.
Animated preschool series. When Egg goes on the run again, Duggee whistles to get him back. The Squirrels want to learn how to whistle too.
Boom hasn't been sleeping and is so tired he crashes into a tree. Zog and the doctors try everything to get him back to sleep.
When the Emperor Penguin visits the berg, he discovers Pancake is a long-lost prince. Pancake learns how to act royal, but all the attention goes to his head.
At a sleepover with Ruby, Rafi wishes their shadows could dance on their own. When they cause mischief, she realises sleepovers are exciting, but you still need to sleep.
The ducklings try to get rid of a bat that has interrupted their game. But Weasy thinks it's supercool and ditches the ducklings to become a comic book hero with a bat sidekick.
Zola is heroic. Aunt May's birthday balloon gets lost.
The Octonauts find a threatened tree that must be moved - the creatures inside disagree.
Puzzle Room. When Pranksy locks the puzzle room door, the spies must solve every riddle to escape.
Ginger must navigate chaos amid rolling Coconutdons and tail-swatting Pineapplesauruses.
Evil Pea chases the Veggies with a giant snowball after covering the supermarket in ice.
Comedy sketch show for younger viewers. Antiques expert Ann Teak gets more than she bargained for when she examines a Georgian dress.
It's class photo day, but Biscuit arrives with a box on her head. When the pups realise she is embarrassed about her 'fur' style, they work together to make her feel better.
Tilly is making spiced chocolate biscuits shaped like beautiful snowflakes.
Aaron, Nelly and Abbie follow Chatterpot's slimy trail to discover how slugs and snails love to munch around in the garden and help keep the garden tidy and magical.
A dusty, old box makes Rebecca sneeze! Murphi dreams up some make ideas to help reveal what's inside, including a tissue box monster and a flamingo sock puppet.
After diving in Balamory Bay, PC Plum dreams of taking the nursery children underwater.
Animated preschool series. There's a parcel for Duggee, and it's wrapped up like a present. Maybe it's Duggee's birthday! The Squirrels decide to throw a party.
Preschool animation. Tweak must help her friend Sandy the sea turtle escape a hungry tiger shark.
Popcorn is afraid of a spooky corn maze. Vida helps him conquer his fear of the unknown.
Glitch takes all of the colourful powder from the Festival of Colour in Dwarka, India.
A playful Big Lizard accidentally breaks his own bath bed. Where will he sleep now.
Stripes worries that the stage isn't loud enough when his hero comes to play a gig.
On a rainy day, the Froglets create a shadow show for Bertie and their puppet friends.
Educational series using Makaton sign language. Mr Tumble looks for a hobby, while Justin meets a friend who plays powerchair football as his hobby.
Chef Ching introduces the Fact Pack to bamboo. They have fun discovering how bamboo is prepared for cooking, and how it can be used in so many other ways.
It's the nursery dance, but Ava feels she can't dance like everyone else.
Winton doesn't want anyone to know about his tummy troubles, but Gadabout struggles to keep the news to himself.
Mum remembers when Bluey and Judo were babies and their race to see who would walk first.
Mae, Bee and the Giant Strawberry. Mae and Bee find a giant strawberry, but they may have bitten off more than they can chew.
Sid wants Tralala to wear her coat outside, but won't the coat get cold too.
Rafi's wish to be in two places at once leads to mix-ups. She realises it's better to focus on one thing at a time.
With help from some kittens, Nick and the Popcasters put on a big concert at the old town hall for two very special mums.
Love Monster want to show Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny's cousin Eager Beaver something new when she visits Fluffytown.
Live-action children's show. Topsy and Tim are growing out of their old, matching twin clothes, so Mummy buys them new jeans.
Dylan wants to help kids get to school safely using his stop sign.
Keith dreams of a pirate adventure. The Piggies build a wheeled ship and sail across Fine Forest for treasure, but Wilf plans to steal it.
Yukee struggles to come up with a tune for a new song. Can Sonny and Paulie help.
Children's sign language poetry series. Donna and Ashley discover Daffodils by William Wordsworth, and A Musical Instrument by Elizabeth Barrett Browning.
When an outbreak of lupine lurgy causes the doctors' patients to howl like wolves, Zog races to treat as many creatures as he can, with chaotic results.
Mum remembers when Bluey and Judo were babies and their race to see who would walk first.

t: Andy and the Band: Rock Star School
d: The Legend of the Odd Socks. The Odd Socks dress as grannies to help the kids book a music legend.
JoJo needs to find different-coloured leaves to complete her nature tick-book, but she can't find a green one. What will she do.
Baba helps rescue a baby seagull when he gets trapped in fishing twine.
I Do Not Ever, Never Want My Wobbly Tooth to Fall Out. Children's animation with siblings Charlie and Lola. Lola has her first wobbly tooth. She does not want a big gap in her teeth.
After finding a paper cone useful for 'loud talking', Mr Onion arrives at a sleepy castle.
MeMo and BaBa enjoy playing with a paper plane and a glider before helping their friends, the Yummies, do something they've never done before - fly high up in the sky.
Children's programme. The Tombliboos are indoors playing with their bricks while Makka Pakka is making piles of stones, but he's missing a stone.
Oh No, George. Mo Gilligan reads a hilarious story about George, a dog who is always tempted to do the wrong thing.
This Is CBeebies. Programmes start at 6.00am.
It's time for a picnic. The Nogglins discover something crunchy, and Fidd slips and slides into trouble.
Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Banana revealing yet another astonishing secret about herself in the opera piece, I've Got a Secret.
Children's animation. Bing and Sula discover a new toy at Amma's creche - a talking ride-on car. It seems like fun until talkie taxi keeps saying the same thing.
Preschool series. The children in Tummy Tales and the Teletubbies both spend some time dancing.
Tee accidently marks Mo's newly cleaned carpet. Uh-oh.
Brown takes the Colourblocks exploring in the forest. Learn different ways to mix brown with the Colourblocks.
Jerry Lee, the chief scientist in the dream house is onboarding a new butler.
The seaside bus breaks down, but Bing still finds a way to have fun.
Preston is in costume as everyone's favourite character, Dewey Dragon, but he isn't ready for how demanding Dewey's fans are. Mojo and Bo need to help him escape the crowd.
The Squirrels are causing a bit too much mess in the clubhouse, so Duggee explains that they need to think more carefully about what they are doing.
The Squirrels are excited to learn more about the natural world.
Dad agrees to play sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum.
When Bluey and Bingo visit Grandad, he takes them on an adventure into the bush.
In Wales, Kym learns to read the signs and finds a starry surprise.
The Tale of the Flying Rabbits. Animated series. When Peter learns that his father once crash-landed a flying machine into Mr McGregor's garden, he vows to find it and pilot it home.
Tweak and Bud find themselves stranded on a floating island made of papyrus reeds.
It's time for karaoke in Numberland. A nervous One discovers that doubling up is a great way to have a friend by your side - and it makes singing twice as fun.
Magenta's mixed-up picture maker accidentally makes funny images.
Love Monster goes camping with Delivery Duckling, but things keep going wrong for him.
Bella and Lift visit Tincy and Brock in the Sing Song Forest, where a unicorn inspires a Tincy Twist and lights up the forest with song.

t: Hey Duggee: Top of the Pups
d: The Numbers Song. Come and join the number jam - it's counting with Duggee.
Bing and Sula are doing a puppet show for Flop, Amma and Pando, and Coco wants to join in. But Bing's loud Biteysaurus isn't welcome, as he is hurting Sula's ears.
Dee encourages a friend to say 'teddy', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see a rainbow teddy, a flying teddy, a fluffy teddy and even a flower teddy.
Tralala brings a periwinkle home and introduces her to an exciting new taste.
Mae, Bee and the Bearded Bake. Mae, Bee and friends eat some magical buns of ageing that turn them 500 years old.
Lou sings a song to conquer his fear but wakes a sleeping dinosaur.
Stop-motion preschool programme. The Twirlywoos visit a garden with a deflated inflatable. The lady brings out a pump and starts pumping up and down.
Educational series using Makaton sign language. Today, Justin takes his friend's pet dog to see a vet. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble pretends to be a vet for his toy patients.
Preschool series. The Teletubbies are flamenco dancing! Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po are surprisingly good.
Giovanna and Baby Bear invite babies and their grown-ups to explore dollies through discovery, play, song and story. Babies and grown-ups at home can join in too.
Elsee plays I-spy during a birthday party with her friends Ethan and Oscar.
Maddie and Triggs discover that the tiniest of indoor sounds can make the biggest noises.
In between practising their competition dance moves, Rebecca and Murphi create a bottle penguin and a pineapple puppet.
Animation set in the Jingly Jangly Jungle. There's a storm in the jungle but no-one is sure what the loud thumps coming from the sky are.
Dad transforms his hand into their old friend Shaun, a chaotic, undisciplined Emu.
Roly has lost his best potato, but Duggee finds it using his sense of smell.

t: Chantelle and Rory's Teeny Tiny Creatures
d: Chantelle visits a school that has a bird box which is currently home to a family of blue tits, whilst Rory meet a young birdwatcher in her garden.
George and Freddie go on an intrepid woodland adventure. Look out for the troll.
Small is trying to grow a sunflower to enter it into the tallest sunflower competition.
Bandage Team. Therapy dog Sylvie and her owner, Katrina, visit the doctor's to help a little boy called Ben feel brave enough to see Dr Stevens about his grazed knee.
Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet bison and red-billed hornbills.
Firefighter Karen shows us her fabulous helmet. We see how important it is for Karen to wear it while she does her heroic job, as well as the amazing things it does.
The after schoolers want Waffle to win the Top Dog competition. But when Pepper needs help, Waffle is happy to step in and assist his sausage dog friend.
Oona is nervous about her first dawn chorus and practises singing with Mama.
It's been snowing in the garden, and Yukee helps Sonny find uses for a large collection of recycled bells.
Lu finds it hard to say goodbye to her favourite uncle.
The Piggies try to teach Wilf how to help others.
Now We Are Six to Ten. Children's animation. Are you sitting comfortably? Then we'll begin a story all about Numberblocks Six to Ten. Learn all about the numbers 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10.
The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. Q sings I Need U, but she can't do it on her own. Unwilling U lends a hand.
Maddie has a colourful day out with her friends, playing games and painting. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble gets messy decorating a cake.
Preschool series. A cloud appears in Teletubbyland and it begins to rain. The Teletubbies watch the flowers bloom. Another cloud appears and it rains pink tubby custard.
Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how city parks play such an important role in the environment.
Maddie visits a barber to find out how hair clippers work and goes to a factory to see how ballet shoes are made.
Grace shows off three incredible machines that all help make roads.
It's the end of term. Otto and his friends wrap up warm and head outside to look for signs of winter in the forest area. Inside, Jud, Leo and Leon cut out paper snowflakes.
Animated deep sea adventures with Captain Barnacles and his explorers. The Octonauts use magnets to try to stop a meteor that is heading towards the Octopod.
The Tale of the Lying Fox. Animated series. When Mr Tod is trapped in Mr McGregor's garden, Peter reluctantly agrees to help him escape.
Tag is feeling grumpy because he didn't eat his breakfast. Luckily, Duggee has his Breakfast Badge, and soon the Squirrels will too.
The Piris believe a seal colony is planning a takeover, but are their fears justified.
Supertato is out chasing a milkshake robot and leaves Broccoli in charge of Tato Tower. Evil Pea tries to take over the tower, but Broccoli puts on a great defence.
The ducklings want to take a beautiful family portrait with their pop, but Weasy can't help making faces and monkeying around.
Betty's ice cream is lifting everyone off the ground. Mojo and Bo need to get them down.
Dad agrees to play sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum.
When Bluey and Bingo visit Grandad, he takes them on an adventure into the bush.
Winton has terrible toothache but isn't ready to lose his fang. Zog and the doctors must help him feel proud again of the way he looks.
PC Plum needs to identify a pesky bird that has been munching his prize strawberries.
Preschool comedy drama series. Ali and Anaya come to play, but Waffle isn't joining in. He's next door with Mrs Hobbs, who is teaching him to be a good dog.
Rafi and Dash want Jake to dance, but he's too busy working. When Rafi makes a wish, Jake can't stop air guitaring, tangoing and break dancing across the bakery kitchen.
JoJo discovers that Gran Gran used to be in a band with Grandad.
When their local park is closed, Sarah and Duck try to find a suitable alternative.
Animation about a family of small creatures who live on, and inside, a planet. A space tortoise is woken up by a mysterious tune Tiny heard coming from the sky.
MeMo and BaBa discover a dandelion clock and have fun blowing the seeds. The Yummies help them plant the seeds, and they marvel at how a seed can become a beautiful flower.
Children's programme. Everybody runs about in the garden so much that Makka Pakka can't wash faces. After a lot of chasing, Makka Pakka finally gets to wash everyone.
Can Bears Ski? Rose Ayling-Ellis signs a Bedtime Story about Little Bear, who is deaf and struggling to understand the world around him.
